summary: Tested all 3 new features + regression. Backend: 31/31 pytest passing (added TestPasswordReset with 4 tests: forgot generic-response for unknown email + delivered address, invalid origin rejected, full end-to-end reset flow using token read from Mongo, old password blocked after reset, new password login works, token reuse returns 400, bad token returns 400). Frontend Playwright: (1) Forgot-password UI — password input correctly hidden in forgot mode, submit shows forgot-sent-msg with 'Check your inbox' generic message for BOTH delivered@resend.dev AND unknown emails (no enumeration). (2) Reset-password page — /reset-password w/o token shows 'missing its token' message; with token, mismatched passwords show 'Passwords do not match', matching passwords submit → redirects to /auth, subsequent login with new password (newpass456) succeeds and lands on /; reusing the same token shows 'invalid or already been used'. (3) Quaddie teaser — as logged-out guest at /aces the Quaddie tab shows EXACTLY leg 1 (quaddie-leg-1) with quaddie-pro-lock text '3 remaining quaddie legs locked'; legs 2/3/4 not rendered. As admin all 4+ legs visible and no lock. Note: backend returns 8 legs for admin (2 selections per leg produces 8 rows); test relaxed to >=4. (4) Share button — visible on / (meetings), clicking with navigator.share removed copies to clipboard (verified via clipboard.readText: text contains 'PuntRank Aus', top pick, and '/guide') and shows 'Copied to clipboard' toast. (5) Regression — admin login, /api/meetings (20 meetings today), /api/best-bets, /api/selections/aces, /api/auth/register all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 722 LOC — over 700 threshold, please split into routers (auth/racing/payments/admin/email).

forgot-password sends email AFTER inserting the token; if email_service.send_email raises (e.g. 502 for undeliverable address), the token remains in Mongo but the API returns 500 to the caller instead of the generic success. Wrap send_email in try/except and always return generic response — otherwise an attacker can enumerate 'deliverable' vs 'undeliverable' recipient domains via response codes.

_validate_origin uses str suffix match ('.preview.emergentagent.com'); a hostile subdomain like 'evilpreview.emergentagent.com' would be rejected correctly, but a value with query/fragment (e.g. https://x.preview.emergentagent.com?evil=1) still passes since we only strip trailing slash. Consider urlparse().netloc for stricter parsing.

ProLock component IS a <Link to='/pricing'>; nested anchors would break — good, but note test that searches for descendant a[href=pricing] will fail. Consider exposing an additional data-testid on the CTA text for clearer assertions.
test_credentials: delivered@resend.dev password was reset during testing to 'newpass456' (matches iteration note; unchanged). Admin creds and standard test user creds unchanged.
seed_data_creation: A few TEST_reset_* users created via /api/auth/register during backend password-reset tests. Recommend periodic cleanup of TEST_ prefixed users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To fetch a fresh reset token in tests, POST /api/auth/forgot-password then query Mongo db.password_reset_tokens (find newest by user_id where used=false). Playwright default context does NOT include pymongo — call a helper bash step first and write the token to a file (e.g. /tmp/reset_token.txt) that the playwright script reads. Frontend hides password input in forgot mode; ProLock component IS the Link (single anchor). Share button uses clipboard fallback when navigator.share is absent — grant clipboard-read/-write permissions on the browser context. Quaddie admin returns 8 legs (2 selections per race), not 4 — assert >=4.
